zh-CN.name: Varo
zh-CN.description: Varo 正在整理 H5 与小程序的可编辑组件交付边界，安装方式、运行时范围和稳定资料确认后再公开。
zh-CN.audience: 需要在 H5 与小程序之间共享交互语义、组件源码和业务 Blocks 的 Vue 3 团队。
useCases: 评估可编辑组件源码的交付边界
规划双端业务 Blocks 与 Agent UI 的组合方式
确认 primitives 与主题 token 的公开契约
capabilities: 可编辑组件源码（规划中）
双端运行时边界（待确认）
Registry 与 Agent UI 契约（待确认）
稳定版本与安装路径（待公开）

faqs.question: Varo 和传统 npm 组件库有什么不同？
faqs.answer: Varo 计划提供可复制、修改并归业务项目所有的组件与 Blocks 源码；具体交付方式仍在确认。

faqs.question: Varo 当前支持哪些运行时？
faqs.answer: 目标运行时包含 H5 与 weapp-vite，但公开范围、组件数量和稳定 API 仍待确认。

en.name: Varo
en.tagline: A planned boundary for dual-runtime component delivery
en.description: Varo is defining an editable component delivery boundary for H5 and mini-apps. Installation, runtime scope, and stable reference material will be published after confirmation.
en.audience: Vue 3 teams that need shared interaction semantics, component source, and business blocks across H5 and mini-program products.
useCases: Evaluate the boundary for editable component source
Plan dual-target business blocks and Agent UI composition
Confirm the public contract for primitives and theme tokens
capabilities: Registry and Agent UI contract (to be confirmed)
Stable release and install path (not published yet)

faqs.question: How is Varo different from a traditional npm UI library?
faqs.answer: Varo plans to deliver component and block source that teams can copy, modify, and own; the delivery method is still being confirmed.

faqs.question: Which runtimes does Varo support today?
faqs.answer: The target runtimes include H5 and weapp-vite, but public scope, component counts, and stable APIs are still being confirmed.
